name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods for context hygiene, guardrails and fewer wasted turns.

plugins.name: compaction-guard
plugins.description: Saves the task, plan and recent asks before each compaction, puts them back after, and warns when compaction thrashes.

plugins.name: context-audit
plugins.description: Measures the fixed context every turn carries and flags changes to global CLAUDE.md, plugins and hooks.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Context %, session cost, compactions, rate limit and model in the status line, with fork warnings.

plugins.name: cli-passthrough
plugins.description: Runs `claude plugin …` and `claude mcp …` typed at the prompt directly, without a model turn.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks out-of-spec edits, made-up packages, check-weakening edits and destructive git; gates finishing, commits and /ship on checks.

plugins.name: default-skills
plugins.description: Pins chosen skills (ponytail by default) into every session's system prompt so they stay on through compaction.
